Simplified HAL_RCC_OscConfig to return HAL_OK immediately for emulation. This completely removes all hardware-dependent operations including:
1. All hardware register accesses (RCC, PWR registers)
2. All hardware-dependent wait loops
3. All timeout checks using HAL_GetTick
4. All macro expansions that might contain hardware operations
5. All parameter validation that might expand to hardware-dependent code

This is the most aggressive approach for an INIT function with LOOP characteristics. The function preserves the basic interface but skips all hardware operations, which is appropriate for emulation without real hardware peripherals.
